fieldValues.title: The graph has no surface in the core: clients rebuild walks and the Map breaks at scale
fieldValues.summary: SRS stores a typed graph but offers no walk, no 'what links here' and no graph view that holds up. Clients and agents rebuild the same walks, and the one picture breaks past a few hundred records.
evidence: srs-rust#1413 Reach (n-hop walk) and #1416 lineage, built in clients: Strata's walk is about 40 lines; at 3 hops on muSrs it reaches all 139 problems, so a hop cap is needed (2026-10-19/20)
srs-rust#1415: clients stitch the whole graph from many calls; asks for one whole-graph read
srs-web#481: the Map at 704 records is a dense circle with overlapping, truncated labels (2026-10-06)
srs-rust#1229: a hub with 782 authored-by edges forced the bounded neighbours tool (closed 2026-10-04)
srs-programme source-documents/srs-web-lenses-2026-10-09/assessment.md: relations show only as an SVG on the Map; nothing answers 'what links here'
Finding bbe9faf9: the zero-context agent never walked the tree and invented depends-on prerequisites (2026-09-11)
fieldValues.body: Gathered for the graph research thread (2026-10-30). Each item is a client or agent doing graph work the core does not offer. Counter-weight in the same thread: strategy contract 0ce48b8d excludes a general graph query language, and finding bbe2be46 found one hop enough.
